description: This file contains unit tests for the FeaturePropertiesCreated class, verifying its immutability, equality logic, JSON serialization/deserialization, and handling of null inputs.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturePropertiesCreated, verifying various functionalities and input handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that FeaturePropertiesCreated instances are immutable and that FeatureProperties are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks equals and hashCode implementations of FeaturePropertiesCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that passing null as a string Thing ID throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that passing null as a ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that passing null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullProperties
methods.description: Tests that passing null properties throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeaturePropertiesCreated instance from valid JSON.
